chapter_seo_title: The Golden Lion King vs the Skeletons - A Philosophical War in the Underworld
chapter_meta_description: The three skeleton kings drive the Golden Lion King mad with eternal questions, then trick him into a hell palace where a terrifying demon and a soft voice await.
og_description: The Golden Lion King faces his most absurd battle yet — three skeletons who won't stop asking 'Who am I?' and a trap that sends him crashing into a legendary demon's palace.
twitter_description: The three skeleton kings use the ancient questions of identity to drive the Golden Lion King into a rage, then trick him into a hell palace connected to Tongtian.
